dict.Cât de tare se înlocuiește culoarea de p: How strongly the edge color is replaced
dict.Face marginea moale a selecției mai tăio: Makes the soft edge of the selection crisper (at 100 % nothing stays half selected)
dict.Scoate tenta fundalului de pe marginea m: Removes the background tint from the soft edge of the selection (for example the green of the grass in cut-out hair): the edge color is taken from the nearest fully selected spot. Works with Feather or a soft-edged selection; the result is a new layer with a mask, the chosen layer stays unchanged.
dict.Pictează peste marginile greu de prins (: Paint over edges that are hard to catch (hair, fur, leaves): there the selection is computed from colors, with a soft edge. Alt + drag removes from the area.
dict.Raza pensulei de rafinare, în pixelii po: Radius of the refine brush, in image pixels
